acc.W: NDGF wildlife management area — open to hunting unless posted closed; motor vehicles only on established roads and parking areas; nonresidents may not hunt on WMAs Oct 10–16. Check posted signs.
acc.P: PLOTS private land — walk-in hunting access only (yellow triangular signs); no motor vehicles without the landowner’s permission; nonresidents may not hunt PLOTS land Oct 10–16.
acc.F: USFWS waterfowl production area — hunting is allowed under federal rules with non-toxic shot; some are posted closed or restricted. Check the refuge district.
acc.T: School trust land — open to non-vehicular public access including hunting unless posted by the Dept. of Trust Lands; check the parcel’s lease and posting.
acc.S: State park or forest — hunting may be restricted or closed; check the managing agency.
acc.G: Federal land (national grassland, BLM, Corps or Reclamation) — generally open to hunting, but parts are restricted; check the managing agency.
